name: llm-finetuning
description: Use when the user asks to fine-tune an open model with LoRA or QLoRA, PEFT, SFT, instruction tuning, TRL SFTTrainer, DPO, train on my data or merge an adapter. Produces a go/no-go decision, chat-format dataset spec, training config, eval plan and serving steps. Not for multi-node training (use distributed-training) or post-training quantization (use llm-model-quantization).
